name: @w6w-apps/jira-data-center
description: Create, search and transition issues on a self-hosted Jira Data Center or Jira Server instance.

w6w.longDescription:
Jira Data Center is Atlassian's self-hosted, clustered deployment of Jira — a genuinely different product from Jira Cloud (the sibling `jira` app in this pack), reachable at whatever domain a customer's IT team gave it rather than a fixed `*.atlassian.net` host. This app treats that instance address the way it treats any self-hosted app's URL — a connection field, not something a manifest can allowlist.

It covers the same day-to-day loop as the Cloud app — creating, searching, updating, transitioning and deleting issues; adding, listing and deleting comments; listing and reading projects; looking up and searching users — adapted to the classic v2 REST API Data Center actually serves: plain wiki-markup strings instead of Atlassian Document Format for descriptions and comment bodies, and usernames instead of Jira Cloud's opaque account ids for assigning issues and identifying people.

Authentication is a Personal Access Token sent as a bearer credential — Atlassian's own recommended method alongside OAuth 2.0, which this version skips because it requires registering an application link inside each target instance's admin console before a single Connection can be made. A username/password Basic method is included as a fallback for instances where PAT creation is disabled. Boards and sprints (the separate agile API), attachments, issue links, worklogs and every admin-only surface are out of scope for a first version.
